comment: Golden-run replay of examples/tower-merge-rush. Read by scripts/golden/replay_developer.py. This file is a mapping only: the Factory holds no game source. `copy` entries are taken from the game repository's own examples/tower-merge-rush/ (the template ships them) and written with a provenance header. `overlays` are directories of the game repository - shipped by the pinned web-game-template commit - holding the hand-made adaptation to the template layout the development brief asks for; each is copied onto the repository root in order (a later one wins), its README.md excepted. The template's boot scene (src/game/boot-scene.ts) is left in place: main.ts no longer starts it, and the template's own SDK matrix harness (tests/sdk-matrix/main.ts) imports it.

Seven-column track.notes: The example's single-row track of seven columns (src/game/rules.ts COLUMNS).

Drop a piece.notes: Tap or click a column, keys 1-7, Space/Enter for the first open column; a drop onto a full column is refused (canDropAt).

Merge and cascade.notes: Equal horizontal neighbours merge into level + 1, the track compacts left and the merge cascades; each merge scores the level it made (resolveMerges).

Drop-level ramp.notes: The next piece's level is 1 + floor(merges / 4), capped at 4 (dropLevelForMerges).

Full track ends the run.notes: A drop that leaves no empty column ends the run (hasLegalMove); the result card shows score and best.

Game flow.notes: Title -> playing -> pause -> game over -> continue / double / restart.

Kill and success criteria telemetry.notes: A run_over event (score, merges) goes through the seam's track(); the default seam sends to NullSink until the integration wires a sink.

Platform integration.notes: Every platform call goes through src/game/integration.ts; the default implementation wraps the template's Platform and withAdBreak.

Localization.notes: All UI strings from public/locales/en.json and ru.json via src/core/i18n.ts; the tower level labels are numerals.

Rewarded placement.notes: continue-game-over (clear the track, keep the score, once per run) and double-score-game-over, granted only when rewarded() resolves true.

Interstitial placement.notes: restart-game-over, at the break before the next run; an unfilled ad never blocks the restart.

One content set with a data-driven diffi.notes: The next piece's level ramps with the merge count (dropLevelForMerges).

Score and personal best, persisted local.notes: Best score saved and loaded through the seam's save/load (platform storage).

Localization: en, ru.notes: en.json and ru.json ship in public/locales/.

how_to_play: Drop numbered towers onto a seven-column track by tapping a column or pressing 1-7; two equal levels side by side merge into the next level and cascade. The run ends when the track is full with no merge left.
known_issues: This build is a deterministic REPLAY of web-game-template's examples/tower-merge-rush, ported into the template layout by the Factory's golden-run replay developer. It is not an AI-developed build and says nothing about an agent developer's ability.
Assets from the asset manifest are placeholders; the game draws everything procedurally and loads none of them.
